answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by gating admission behind a vouching bond: each new key needs an established account staking collateral, slashed if that newcomer is convicted of cloning. Each extra key needs another backer's coins at risk, so self-vouching bets one's stake on a fraud. A split fortune still means N clones need N bonds. The scarce resource is accountable endorsement; an adjudicator must convict clones. Like a cedar's one root against a knoll of shallow copies, one identity has one sponsor; each sponsorship a short signed sonnet the backer cannot revise.
